title: Mall Ka Darwaza Khud Kaise Khulta Hai? 🤔 #shorts
description:
Mall ka darwaza aapko dekhta nahi, phir bhi aapke aate hi khul jaata hai. Asli raaz ek echo ki pitch mein chhupa hai.
📡 Sensor 24.125 GHz ki microwave bhejta hai aur unka echo sunta hai
🚶 1 m/s se chalne par echo lagbhag 161 Hz shift hota hai: yahi Doppler effect hai
⚡ Shift threshold cross kare to relay click karta hai aur motor door kholti hai
🛑 Ruk gaye to shift zero ho jaata hai, isliye infrared presence sensor door khula rakhta hai
🔔 Aise hi electronics explainers ke liye subscribe karo!
#shorts #automaticdoor #dopplereffect #sensor #electronics #hindi #howitworks
